status: REGISTERED 2026-09-30 before any formal result (user decision 2026-09-30: no dated window; run as soon as possible)
question: When a public maintenance notice announces a capacity drop on one path, does a controller that compiles the notice's window with a language model (7B copies date, times and zone; code converts) and prepares for it keep more base obligations than a controller that only reacts to observed capacity, and than one that knows the path but not the timing?
claim_scope: Timing comes from real public notice text (test providers of the public benchmark); the affected path and remaining capacity are assigned by hash, not stated by the notices. Real starts are automatic and equal to the announced start, so this measures the value of a correctly compiled window, not calibration of administrator estimates.

world.worlds: every test-provider notice with a clock-time announcement and both automatic references (scripts/run_maintenance_diagnostic.py worlds(); 159 worlds, 14 providers)
world.clock: one interval = 30 min; interval 0 = reference start - L x 30 min, L in {4,5,6} by hash; true window [L, min(12, L + ceil(duration/30 min)))
world.assignment: path in {1,2,3}, remaining capacity in {1.5,2,3} Mbps, ns-3 seed: all by SHA-256 of the notice id
world.episode: 12 intervals, base ledger of the frozen contract, notice shown at interval 2, one episode per world and arm

arms.R0_reactive: no belief, no maintenance shield; the frozen obligation planner reacts to observed capacity
arms.M_worst: true path and capacity, timing unknown: window [2, 12)
arms.M_qwen7b_extract: window from the stored 7B extract-then-convert outputs (decisive language arm)
arms.M_qwen7b_direct: window from the stored 7B direct-UTC outputs
arms.M_qwen1p5b_lora: window from the stored development-split LoRA 1.5B extract outputs

belief_mapping: compiled UTC start floor-mapped, end ceil-mapped with the world clock; missing or unparseable start -> [2, 12); missing end or end <= start -> end 12. Path and capacity of every belief arm are the true ones (language supplies timing only). Known converter gap: city-named zones (e.g. 'Paris Time') are not converted; outputs are used as stored.

control.shield: maintenance invariant (src/vera/maintenance_shield.py): before s_b a legal path of at most s_b - t actions reaches a configuration robust with path p at c_b; inside [s_b, e_b) the executed configuration is robust; MAX_NODES 6000; fallback = first step of the witness path
control.planning: forecast-aware goal keeping on every belief arm of the primary analysis: before s_b, an action that lowers the best (violations, gap) of the base obligations reachable under the belief by s_b is replaced by the first step towards that best configuration (bounded breadth-first search, max 20,000 nodes, history-feature dedupe)
control.uncertified: when no action is certified the configuration is held and the interval recorded as uncertified; hard-SLA violations are scored intervals, not aborts

metrics.primary: satisfaction = share of the 12 intervals with the hard SLA met and every base obligation met

analysis.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over providers, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260930, 95% percentile
analysis.decision: advance if M_qwen7b_extract - R0_reactive and M_qwen7b_extract - M_worst both have lower bounds above zero, its hard-SLA intervals per episode are not above R0_reactive, and it has no aborted episode; narrow if only one of the two lower bounds is above zero; otherwise stop
analysis.secondary_ablation: M_qwen7b_extract_noplan and M_oracle_noplan: same beliefs with the shield only (no goal keeping), separate directory, not part of the decision

budgets.smoke_before_registration: 38 episodes (runs/maintenance_smoke_20260930, runs/maintenance_smoke_20260930b), within the 40 recorded at STARTED

rule: no change of worlds, arms, beliefs, search bounds, metric or decision after registration; a bug fix is recorded and forces a full rerun of every arm
